title: Private Houston Brewery Tour by Cart
includes: We are your designated drivers to show you the breweries in a fancy electric cart.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Taste your way through Houston’s beer and spirits scene! This cart tour is the best way to visit some of Houston’s top breweries and/or distilleries. Sit back and relax with your friends while we take you to four Houston breweries and/or distilleries.
